summary.zh: 设计规范的 REST 与 GraphQL 接口
summary.en: Design clear, maintainable REST and GraphQL APIs

description.zh: 梳理资源命名、HTTP 方法语义、分页与错误格式、版本演进，以及 GraphQL schema 与查询复杂度控制等要点。适合设计新接口、评审 API 规范或为团队定下统一风格时使用。
description.en: Covers resource naming, HTTP method semantics, pagination, error formats, versioning, and GraphQL schema and query-complexity control. Use it when designing new endpoints, reviewing an API spec, or setting team-wide conventions.
